result.instructions: Tools for Papaya Global, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is the balance of each of our payment wallets?"; "Show the payments executed last week that are not final yet."; "List the beneficiaries in Germany that need attention.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Papaya Global data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run papayaglobal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run papayaglobal_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run papayaglobal_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. papayaglobal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: papayaglobal_list_wallets
tools.title: List wallets
tools.description: List the payment wallets of the organization with currency, balance, state and funding details. Good first call. Papaya API: GET /payments/wallets.

active_only.description: true = active wallets only; false = all wallets.

tools.name: papayaglobal_get_wallet_statement
tools.title: Get wallet statement
tools.description: Get the transactions (credits and debits) of one wallet in a date range, with fees and the wallet balance. Papaya API: GET /payments/wallets/{id}/statement.

tools.name: papayaglobal_list_payment_groups
tools.title: List payment groups
tools.description: List payment groups (pay runs) with their wallet, lock state and tags. Papaya API: GET /payments/groups.

tools.name: papayaglobal_get_payment_group
tools.title: Get a payment group
tools.description: Get one payment group by id. Papaya API: GET /payments/groups/{id}.

tools.name: papayaglobal_list_beneficiaries
tools.title: List beneficiaries
tools.description: List the payees (beneficiaries) with name, currency, status and bank details. Papaya API: GET /payments/beneficiaries.

tools.name: papayaglobal_get_beneficiary
tools.title: Get a beneficiary
tools.description: Get one beneficiary by id, with status and the next upcoming payment. Papaya API: GET /payments/beneficiaries/{id}.

tools.name: papayaglobal_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payment instructions with amount, approval and execution state. Filter by date, approval and finality. Papaya API: GET /payments/payments.

amount_type.description: SEND = amount debited; LAND = amount credited.

approved.description: Only approved (true) or not approved (false) payments.

final.description: Only final (true) or not final (false) payments.

tools.name: papayaglobal_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Get one payment instruction by id with amount, approval, execution and issues. Papaya API: GET /payments/payments/{id}.
